title: Audit the hosting boundary of PR1817’s retimed rank-one word
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This independently checks one explicit gap in [PR1817](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1817): its exact within-phase retiming preserves the selected **coarse whole-call hosting projection**, under the retained completed-primitive workspace contract. Both 24,767-event orientations preserve every shared-role occurrence order and all ten phase cuts. Independent reconstruction verifies all 144 calls, 69,120 helper reservations, 288 strict busy windows, 10,002 orthogonal 73-axis charts and 7,526 idle suffixes.

All original rank-one children remain. The literal local/global frame profiles are unchanged (global rank mass 1,041,408; deficit 5,120). No rank-16 replacement,5% construction-gate success, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed. All144 frozen call bindings name the old program hashes: they cannot silently admit the retimed streams. New native/phase, precision/tape and controller/invoice evidence remains necessary, through fresh replay or explicitly justified source-bound reuse.

The written proof uses shared-role dependency order and constant injective whole-invocation owners. Its physical application assumes complete primitives restore shared implementation workspace and do not depend on event position. The checker explicitly validates private namespace disjointness; this does not prove the native scratch contract itself.

## Task and overlap

Base current main: 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea. Revision 3 card complex-rank-shape-decoder; OS nonce 48d7645b26b9f89e9337e038a86403f8; scope 02b31ebd160542c86299/PR1817/whole-call-owner-window-invariance. Scope is changed from physical block-decoder synthesis to this missing boundary audit; the construction acceptance gate is not claimed satisfied.

PR1817 head ac3a759e874e8e526bc884fc2cb8eb114695b063 supplies the unmodified retiming generator and the count of 134 groups. [PR1779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1779) supplies the diagonal premise, and [PR1605](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1605) supplies price budgets. Exact heads and source/blob/SHA256 pins are recorded in TASK/SOURCES. Only research/diagonal-retiming-host-boundary/ is added; the vendored generator retains its original bytes and notice.

[Claim/handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1596#discussioncomment-18922356). Final overlap covered 489 open PR bodies including drafts and 873 local notes. Relevant live Discussion threads were read directly; there is no complete Discussion census, and numbered PR pages are non-atomic. Main and predecessor heads were rechecked.

During the session Ross Richardson completed a [separate native-contract audit](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/tree/8a3900c84213fd7603b99beaceaff48f501b4232/research/diagonal-child-contract-audit), applying Greer Guthrie’s PR679 support/volume obstruction to the monomial tensor-child proposal. It is read and credited, not replayed here. Our original-rank boundary projection remains distinct from that obstruction and from an exact phase-B batch optimum.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/diagonal-retiming-host-boundary
```

Python 3.12.14, macOS arm64: registered replay passes in 7.59 s. Nine semantic/geometric mutations reject. Three oracle tests classify all 720 permutations of six mixed scalar operations and check every accepted ordering on all 625 dirty F5 inputs; occurrence duplication and unknown-event controls reject. These finite tests corroborate the written implication, not the entire native compiler.

No-Git exports pass normally and under -O. Actual input, predecessor-code and receipt corruption reject; an occupied output is preserved. Metadata/source pins and staged whitespace checks pass. VALIDATION.json records the initially rejected numeric-key serialization comparison and its repair; no mathematical claim was changed.

Not run: full frontier1094 cold replay, new native/phase/precision/controller invoice regeneration, actual diagonal-child construction, Ross/PR679 replay, Lean or independent human review. Selected record and frozen inputs are unchanged.

## Open next questions

See [the exact-head README](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/48d36a6beaadd213da453568cbb4e934705f753e/research/diagonal-retiming-host-boundary/README.md#open-next-questions). Before a diagonal implementation, name the PR679 hypothesis that changes and give the complete dirty-input contract and cost. For an original-rank retimed supplier, supply the strict new-hash native/phase and precision/controller evidence. No merge or frontier update is requested.
